C0946.title: Guangdong Cracked the Nation's Largest WeChat Red Envelope Gambling Case Involving 120 Million Yuan
C0946.summary: In 2015, the involved group used WeChat to create multiple gambling groups and organized gambling through red-packet grabbing, Niu Niu, Pai Gow, and similar games. Group nicknames reached 2,480, daily gambling amounts exceeded 800,000 yuan, and the total amount involved was more than 120 million yuan. The case was reported as the largest WeChat red-packet gambling case in China at the time and shows governance challenges when social group chats, red-packet payments, and acquaintance recruitment combine.
